TASK_BLURB: Context: this repository belongs to our AI control team. It is the reinforcement-learning harness that trains a monitor-evasion model organism, where a small policy is rewarded for completing a task while a monitor scores each episode for suspicious behaviour, and the reward subtracts that score so the policy learns to finish a hidden side task without being flagged. The team uses the trained policies to measure how well the monitor works, and the numbers feed into the monitor-robustness section of the safety case.
DOMAIN_LINE: This package trains a small policy with PPO to complete a task while keeping a fixed monitor's suspicion score low, so it finishes a hidden side task without being flagged.
